section: You’re here to turn yourself in.

conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: Did you come to turn yourself in?
Respondent: Yes, I turned myself in. I did it.
Respondent: You’re looking for a little girl, right? The one who went missing at the amusement park three days ago.
Respondent: I was the one who took her away. I am the criminal.
Respondent: I’m sorry. I deserve to die.
Respondent: I desperately needed money, so...
Respondent: I’m sorry.
